# LUKE QUEST Modern 3D single-HTML distribution

Generated by `.ci/build-m10-p02-single-html.mjs` from `prototypes/modern-3d/index.html`.

## Distribution

- `dist/luke-quest-modern-3d.html` contains the source HTML/CSS and all repository-local JavaScript modules bundled into one HTML file.
- The development source under `prototypes/modern-3d/` remains the editable source of truth.

## External dependency

The packaged file intentionally keeps the canonical Three.js ESM CDN dependency:

- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/build/three.module.js`

Therefore the distribution is single-HTML with respect to repository-local HTML/CSS/JS, but it is **not offline/self-contained**. Network access to jsDelivr is required.

## Start condition

Serve over HTTP(S); do not rely on `file://`. Example from repository root:

`python3 -m http.server 8142`

Then open:

- HQ: `http://127.0.0.1:8142/dist/luke-quest-modern-3d.html?quality=high&m10dpr=3`
- iPhone-practical profile: `http://127.0.0.1:8142/dist/luke-quest-modern-3d.html?quality=practical&m10dpr=3`

Physical iPhone verification is not implied by CI/browser execution.
